recipient_name.description: The hiring manager or recruitment team (e.g., 'Hiring Manager' or 'Talent Acquisition Team').

opening_hook.description: A compelling 1-2 sentence opening that names the role, the company, and why the candidate is drawn to it based on the strategic_value.

body_paragraphs.description: 2-4 grounded paragraphs. Each paragraph must include text plus evidence IDs from the master profile ledger.

closing_statement.description: A confident closing sentence reiterating enthusiasm and requesting an interview.
